# alejandro-is.me

> Personal portfolio of Alejandro Amaro Mendoza — Product & Visual Designer based in Strasbourg, France.

## Site Structure

- **Homepage** (`/`): Single-page landing with hero, about, skills, experience, projects, education, and contact sections.
- **Portfolio** (`/portfolio.html`): Filterable grid of all case studies.
- **Projects** (`/projects/`): Individual case study pages:
  - BEDiZEN — Capstone project for the CCI Campus Alsace Web UX/UI Designer certification. Brand, UX/UI design, self-coded front-end (HTML/CSS, then Tailwind CSS), PHP, and WordPress on O2switch hosting
  - Spin App — Brand and UX redesign of a mobile top-up app. Not implemented for lack of funding; a design process piece, not a shipped product
  - WorkPics — Logo and app screens for a developer friend's field reporting app for construction teams, published on Google Play
  - Cinéville Festival — Surrealist visual identity for a film festival
  - Keep Breathing — Award-winning game jam survival FPS (Best Technical Achievement, GGJ 2026)
  - Other Works — Illustration, logo design, and digital art gallery

## Contact

- Email: ale.amaro.m@proton.me

## Technologies

Built with Jekyll (static site generator), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Hosted on GitHub Pages.
